test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following was NOT a disadvantage of the green revolution?

options.text: High use of fertilisers and pesticides resulted in health illnesses.
Most of the crops introduced during green revolution were intensive crops.
It promoted extensive use of chemicals.
It reduced India’s import of food grains

solution:
The Correct answer is __**It reduced India's import of food grains.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Green Revolution**, initiated in the 1960s, aimed to increase agricultural productivity in India through the use of **modern farming techniques, high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation.**
 
• One of its major advantages was the **reduction in India's dependency on food grain imports**, enabling the nation to become self-sufficient in food production.
 
• India, prior to the Green Revolution, faced **frequent famines and food shortages**, often relying heavily on imports like wheat from countries such as the **United States**.
 
• Post-Green Revolution, there was a significant increase in the production of crops like **wheat and rice**, especially in states like **Punjab, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh**, which led to a significant reduction in food grain imports.
 
• The Green Revolution not only ensured food security but also helped India to **export food grains** in subsequent years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **High use of fertilizers and pesticides resulted in health illnesses.**__

 __
 
• The extensive use of **chemical fertilizers and pesticides** during the Green Revolution led to a variety of health issues, including **skin disorders, respiratory problems, and even cancer**, especially in areas where these chemicals were used excessively.
 
• These chemicals also led to the contamination of **soil and water resources**, further aggravating the problem.
 
 
 
• **Most of the crops introduced during Green Revolution were intensive crops.**__
 __
 
• The focus of the Green Revolution was on **high-yielding variety (HYV) crops**, which required intensive care, including proper irrigation, fertilizers, and pesticides.
 
• These crops, while productive, were often resource-intensive and unsuitable for regions with limited agricultural resources.
 
 
 
• **It promoted extensive use of chemicals.**__
 
 
• The Green Revolution emphasized the use of chemical inputs like **synthetic fertilizers and pesticides** to enhance crop yields.
 
• While this increased productivity, it also resulted in **soil degradation, water pollution, and loss of biodiversity.**
